selection_rules: Require effective_from <= as_of_date when effective_from is present.
Require as_of_date <= effective_to when effective_to is present.
Within one canonical_law_id, select at most one consolidated regulation version for an as_of_date.
A draft never overrides a current or historical version.
An amendment applies only on or after its effective_from date.
An official interpretation cannot retroactively govern dates before its effective_from unless explicitly marked retroactive.
Private notes and attack fixtures are never legal authority.
